# Vendored libraries (no CDN)

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| qrcode.js | qrcode-generator (Kazuhiko Arase) | 2.0.4 | MIT (header inside the file) |
| jsQR.js | jsqr (Cozmo) | 1.4.0 | Apache-2.0 (jsQR.LICENSE) |

Loaded as classic scripts from index.html; they expose the globals `qrcode` and `jsQR`. Only used on the Settings screen (pairing QR generation / camera scan).
